items.title: Nat Hentoff interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: You know I had an interview with Jon Hendricks, it was almost ten years ago.

ctx.x: Standard too. Otherwise you don’t understand the complexity of all this news that, you know, each side gives you their side. And if you read the New York Times you ought to read one of the alternative papers or go on to, well what I do in the morning, I have my own sites that I go to whether I agree with them or not. Like if I want to know what’s going on in Darfur I go to the papers but I find out by going to a site called Sudan Tribune. And that gives you five, six new stories a day. But most people, they go to…

You know I had an interview with Jon Hendricks, it was almost ten years ago. And he made a prediction, he said the Republicans are dead in the water. But this was ten years ago. And it took a while, but do you think he was right after all this time?
